attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as an inter-LAN router between lan-a (node2) and lan-b (node3) using an Ansible playbook run from control node4. node2 and node3 now reach each other on any port with original source addresses preserved (pure routing, no NAT/masquerade). Completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol on all four managed nodes, with proof of changed boot identity and post-restart recovery for each.
